tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an instant total quote for a physical task in Japan: shopping proxy (including limited-edition and in-store-only items), in-store stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations in Japanese, queueing / standing in line, or package forwarding. The total is itemised (item pr

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accept a quote. IMPORTANT: this does not confirm execution. The request enters pending_review; a human operator confirms or declines each request individually during the launch phase. No timeline is promised. Poll get_task_status for the outcome. Payment: pay_with 'card' (default, Stripe) or 'jpyc'

tools.name: decline_quote
tools.description: Decline a quote and close it. Declining a quote you have not accepted is free of charge; no handling fee applies.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a quote or task by id (quote_id q_… or task_id t_…). Brief by default; pass full: true for the complete record. For tasks, the access_token is required. To leave a note for the operator, use send_message.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the human operator about a quote or task. The operator's replies appear in the messages of get_task_status.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Get evidence attached to a task (photos, records, tracking numbers). Evidence is returned even for failed tasks.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a quote that has not been accepted yet, or a task that is in pending_review, confirmed, or in_progress. Cancelling an unaccepted quote is free. confidence.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
confidence.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_anything · Private data: list_services, request_quote, get_task_status, get_evidence, cancel_task · Public sink: list_services, send_message, request_anything.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_anything · Private data: list_services, request_quote, get_task_status, get_evidence, cancel_task · Public sink: list_services, send_message, request_anything

confidence.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
